summary: Backend: 13/14 pytest tests passing (93%). Frontend: Login, navigation, role-based UI, and Opening Checklist CRUD/toggle/submit-button flow all verified working on mobile viewport (390x844). Auth flow (Admin/1234), home screen (Store Operations, Inventory & Orders, Manage Users admin card), operations screen (4 cards), and opening checklist add+toggle confirmed end-to-end.

minor.issue: Server intends to close with code 4401 but Kubernetes ingress rejects with HTTP 403 BEFORE the WebSocket handshake reaches FastAPI, so clients never observe close code 4401. Functionally invalid tokens are rejected (security intact), but the documented close-code contract is not observable through the public ingress. Consider returning 401/403 at handshake (no upgrade) or document this behavior.

issues: shadow* style props deprecated warnings in console (cosmetic, RN web). Use boxShadow.
Add (+) button on Opening Checklist has no accessible name/testID; testers must click by coordinate. Recommend testID like 'opening-add-task-btn' on the + IconButton.
Task title element lacks a dedicated testID; toggling relies on text content matching.
Login form inputs lack testIDs (login-name-input, login-pin-input, login-submit).

action_items: Add testID props to interactive elements: login-name-input, login-pin-input, login-submit, opening-add-task-btn, task-row-{id}, chat-input, chat-send-btn, accounting-entry-{head_id}. Will make future UI testing more reliable.

Optional: document WS invalid-token behavior (ingress returns HTTP 403, not RFC 6455 close code 4401). If strict 4401 contract is required, this likely needs ingress-level changes which is outside frontend/backend scope.
Replace deprecated shadow* style props with boxShadow to silence React Native Web warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 535-line file; acceptable for MVP but consider splitting into routers/auth.py, routers/checklists.py, routers/accounting.py, routers/chat.py as it grows.
JWT_SECRET falls back to a hardcoded default — fine for dev but ensure JWT_SECRET is set in production env.
_id is correctly excluded everywhere via projections. Good.
Pydantic models and Literal usage are solid; status codes (201/400/401/403/404) used appropriately.
WebSocket auth via query param token is acceptable; consider rate-limiting and per-user connection caps in future.
seed_data_creation: Default admin (Admin/1234) is auto-seeded by backend startup. Tests create TEST_-prefixed employees, tasks, and account heads and clean them up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL key in frontend/.env is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Login button text is 'Sign In'. Plus (+) button on Opening/Closing checklist has no text and no testID — click by coordinate near right edge of task input row. Backend WS path: wss://<host>/api/ws/chat?token=<jwt>. Invalid token WS connections are rejected at the ingress (HTTP 403) rather than reaching FastAPI's close(4401).
rca_of_issue: WS invalid-token test: K8s/nginx ingress likely intercepts WebSocket upgrade requests and returns 403 before they reach uvicorn. FastAPI code is correct (does decode_token then close(4401)).
